title: Project Unity flagged by the DoD as a Russian disinformation platform

tellings.quote: well I got told that I was flagged as a Russian disinformation platform by the DoD apparently but they're still letting me in the country so I was flagged as Russian

plain: Jay Anderson, who runs a platform called Project Unity, says he was told that the US Department of Defense had flagged him as "a Russian disinformation platform", meaning a channel spreading Russian propaganda. He does not say who told him or when, and he jokes that "they're still letting me in the country."
